pages.text: Follow timber frames or an open shaft into a $(l:world/collapsed_mines)collapsed mine$(). Mineralized fallen workers show a purple core on their faces. Break a corpse to collect exactly one damaged core. Slimeballs cannot revive a corpse directly.

Supply chests contain one Old Command Fragment and one slimeball per corpse, a pickaxe, and cobblestone. Forgotten workers and a Mine Guardian remain on watch. Defeating a mine remnant yourself or with a companion yields one core and one fragment under normal mob-loot rules.

Return to the Overworld. Hold a mine core and use a $(l:world/restoration)Slime Restoration Station$() with one fragment and one slimeball in your inventory. A mining core becomes an $(l:companions/ancient_mining)Ancient Mining Slime$(); a tunnel core becomes an $(l:companions/ancient_tunnel)Ancient Tunnel Slime$(). Mine Guardians become Royal Guards.

The restored summon item is a new owned companion. It starts waiting at one health; heal and equip it before ordering work. A core can be restored once across the saved world. Older empty remains have no core. Your fallen companions keep their ordinary $(l:care/revival)revival$() procedure.
